Omdb._comment: OMDb API key comes from the Render env var Omdb__ApiKey (double underscore → maps to Omdb:ApiKey). Keep this blank — never commit a key here.

CineMind._comment: Set both as Render env vars: CineMind__PuzzleSalt and CineMind__AdminSecret (double underscore). Keep both blank here. PuzzleSalt: without it the daily puzzle is still deterministic but becomes guessable in advance. AdminSecret: gates POST /api/game/catalog/seed (header x-admin-secret) — pick any random string.
